question: What was the amount spent in millions of nominal dollars by the highest spending U.S Federal Department in the fiscal year of 1955?
raw_response:
The highest-spending federal department in fiscal year 1955 was the Defense Department. Its expenditures were 35,532 for military functions plus 548 for civil functions, totaling 36,080 million nominal dollars.

<FINAL_ANSWER>36,080</FINAL_ANSWER>
